seoTitle: AgenticDraft — AEM automation, from ticket to production
seoDescription: AgenticDraft builds governed agentic automation for Adobe Experience Manager and Edge Delivery Services.

hero.headline: From ticket to production.
hero.lede: AgenticDraft connects requirements, design, implementation, testing, verification, and pull-request preparation in one governed workflow for Adobe Experience Manager teams.

approach.heading: Automation that carries context
approach.intro: AEM delivery crosses tickets, repositories, designs, content, browsers, and release controls. AgenticDraft connects that working context from one stage to the next.

principles.title: Config-driven
principles.body: Your build commands, conventions, and branch rules live in one shared configuration—not scattered prompts.

principles.title: Context-connected
principles.body: Bring together work items, codebases, Figma designs, live AEM content, and browser evidence.

principles.title: Governed by design
principles.body: Readiness checks, validation gates, accessibility review, and secret scanning stay inside the workflow.

workflow.heading: From requirements to a
workflow.intro: Move through a structured delivery lifecycle. Each stage produces durable output that informs the next.

steps.title: Requirements
steps.body: Fetch the ticket, validate readiness, distill requirements, and research the codebase.

steps.title: Design to code
steps.body: Extract design context, generate a convention-aware prototype, and verify visual fidelity.

steps.title: Plan + build
steps.body: Create an implementation plan, resolve risks, and execute with review and test loops.

steps.title: Verify + ship
steps.body: Compile, lint, test, scan, review architecture, and prepare a traceable pull request.

closing.eyebrow: Shape the workflow around your team
closing.heading: A governed AEM workflow,
